issues.description: The UML in the problem statement indicates Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal) should return boolean, but the provided solution implements addAnimal(Animal) with a void return type. This mismatch can confuse students about whether they should implement addAnimal to return a boolean or void and may lead to incorrect implementations relative to the reference solution and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and templates consistent: either change the UML in problem_statement.md to indicate addAnimal(Animal): void (and update any textual references) or change the solution and template to implement addAnimal returning boolean (e.g., return true when added). Prefer updating the UML to void to match the current solution and example usage in Main, or explicitly document the intended return behavior.
